policies.title: Kazakhstani ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Kazakhstan MFA's ordinary-passport matrix identifies Chad as visa-subject, while Chad requires new visa applications exclusively through its electronic platform before travel.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Kazakhstan passport: the current Kazakhstan MFA matrix labels Chad's ordinary-passport row 'visa'.
Apply through Chad's official eVisa platform before travel; standard processing is 10 working days and express processing is 72 hours.
Approval, documentary, health, security, carrier and final border-admission checks remain applicable.

application.label: Chad official e-Visa platform
application.processingTime: 10 working days standard or 72 hours express.
steps: Submit the ordinary Kazakhstan-passport visitor application online before travel.
Travel only after issuance and retain the required supporting documents.
